nodes.rationale: Owner activation checks the confirmed email server-side so others cannot claim it; staff access is checked against the database so removing a staff row revokes access immediately.

nodes.label: Supabase backend (pinned JS client, no service role key on client)
nodes.norm_label: supabase backend (pinned js client, no service role key on client)
nodes.rationale: Public URL and anon key are fetched at runtime and kept in Vercel environment variables so nothing secret is committed; the service credential lives only in the Edge Function runtime.

nodes.label: WhatsApp orders stored as whatsapp_pending
nodes.rationale: Opening WhatsApp cannot prove a message was sent, so a staff member must confirm receipt.

nodes.label: ingredient-settle animation
nodes.rationale: Preserves the center translation and rotation in both keyframes so placed pieces stay inside the manoushe filling circle.

nodes.label: American pizza renderer with own crust and cheese assets
nodes.norm_label: american pizza renderer with own crust and cheese assets
nodes.rationale: American style needs a uniform medium-thick rim without leopard char, so it gets its own crust and cheese while Italian and manakish renderers keep theirs.

nodes.label: Lemon squeeze transient effect
nodes.rationale: Used as a moving squeeze with code-animated juice droplets; never scattered onto the dough.

nodes.label: AmericanPizza (sole user of square assets)
nodes.rationale: Square sauce clipping and a rectangular topping distribution preserve the four-corner shape.

nodes.label: Natural square topping distribution
nodes.rationale: Replaces rows with natural scatter; small dessert pieces stay within the chocolate surface while menu photos, prices, category restrictions and order logic are preserved.

nodes.label: Grilled Green Pepper Strips Topping Sprite
nodes.norm_label: grilled green pepper strips topping sprite

nodes.label: oven-real.webp stone oven scene
nodes.rationale: Oven motion is a UI animation of photographic layers, not a recorded oven video; the floor is left empty so a pizza can be composited onto it.

nodes.label: Neapolitan ingredient layers (dough, sauce, cheese, pepperoni, mushroom, olive, pepper, onion, basil, tomato, meat, turkey)
nodes.norm_label: neapolitan ingredient layers (dough, sauce, cheese, pepperoni, mushroom, olive, pepper, onion, basil, tomato, meat, turkey)
nodes.rationale: Each ingredient is a full-canvas layer of separated pieces; original PNGs stay untouched and CSS crops individual cutouts for natural placement.

nodes.norm_label: shared photographic brief (overhead, diffuse light, transparent)

nodes.label: Builder dialog (oven, pizza stage, size, toppings)
nodes.norm_label: builder dialog (oven, pizza stage, size, toppings)

nodes.label: Pizza customizer with generated photographic cutouts
nodes.norm_label: pizza customizer with generated photographic cutouts
nodes.rationale: Generated images illustrate customization and are not photographs of the actual products; source layers are preserved and ingredient bounding boxes are composed with CSS for natural distribution.

nodes.label: Full-Disk Spread Layer
nodes.rationale: Base toppings are pre-rendered as a single round disk matching the dough's shape, so one image covers the whole flatbread instead of many placed pieces.

nodes.label: Manakish Builder Ingredient Sprites
nodes.rationale: Photorealistic top-down cutouts on transparent backgrounds so ingredients can be composited in layers over the dough image in the interactive manakish builder.

nodes.label: Scatter Topping Pieces
nodes.rationale: Discrete toppings ship as sheets of several distinct piece variants (or single pieces) so the builder can scatter individual pieces without visible repetition.
